name: sort
gotchas: matSort must be placed on the same element as mat-table, with the data source's `.sort` set to a `@ViewChild(MatSort)` reference — placing it on an unrelated ancestor has no effect.

MatTableDataSource's default sort comparator does a plain value comparison; for computed or nested properties, set `dataSource.sortingDataAccessor` rather than trying to configure the comparator on MatSort itself.
Setting `[matSortActive]`/`[matSortDirection]` initializes the header UI but does not itself emit `(matSortChange)` — read `dataSource.sort` after assignment if you need the sorted data immediately.
